definitions.gloss: proper use, selective use, using differently depending on context
definitions.explanation: The practice of choosing different tools, words, or methods depending on the situation or purpose. Implies skillful selection of the appropriate option for each context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使|つか}い{分|わ}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Properly using different levels of keigo is difficult.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use) + ⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧ (to divide, distinguish). As a noun, it often appears in the pattern 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使|つか}い{分|わ}け. As a verb, it conjugates as an ichidan verb: {使|つか}い{分|わ}ける. Particularly common in discussions about language usage, tools, and technology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使|つか}い{分|わ}け (choosing words appropriately)
- ⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使|つか}い{分|わ}け (proper use of honorific language)
- ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける (use different tools for different purposes)
